svg.title: Forklift operator — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as forklift operator, wearing a safety vest and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A side-view forklift has an open driver guard, seat, raised mast, projecting fork and two differently sized wheels. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat and round glasses.
